nodes.label: split_award_suffix
nodes.rationale: Reuses the existing 'x<digits>' repeat-award convention already implemented by build_cell_value and AddModal's Suffix step, splitting the trailing count indicator off before catalog matching so text like 'Afghanistan Campaign x1' can still match the catalog's base name entry.

nodes.label: flatten_audit_findings
nodes.rationale: Reuses AuditReport's four existing vectors instead of redesigning collect_sheet_audit, keeping the audit's already-tested scan logic and byte-identical report output unchanged; keeps awards-core pure/no-I/O per the Code Quality principle and ships with its own unit tests per Testing Standards.

nodes.label: AuditFinding::to_award
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the existing DuplicateHit::to_award() pattern so the existing action_edit/action_delete modal-construction code paths are reused verbatim, satisfying FR-008 (no new or lesser-guarded write surface) and preserving the existing typed-confirmation gate.

nodes.label: match_catalog_entries
nodes.rationale: Factors AddModal::reload's existing inline case-insensitive substring predicate out into awards-core so a paste-driven match behaves exactly as manual Pick-step filtering would; a fuzzy/edit-distance match (the existing strsim dependency) was rejected as unsafe for resolving to the wrong award on a live sheet write.

nodes.label: Bracketed Paste Mode (crossterm)
nodes.rationale: Enabling crossterm's existing EnableBracketedPaste/Event::Paste support delivers a multi-line Discord message as one atomic string instead of a burst of keystrokes, avoiding an unusual key chord (e.g. Ctrl+Enter) and requiring no new dependency; terminals lacking support gracefully degrade to the existing manual Lookup+Add flow.

nodes.label: extract_paste_fields
nodes.rationale: A case-insensitive labeled-line scan tolerant of whitespace/label wording, stripping Markdown emphasis and @-mention artifacts, and reusing the existing parse_bare_username validator, was chosen over free-text NLP-style guessing or a rigid fixed-format parser, since the two real Discord samples already differ in field order and wording.

nodes.label: Local Audit Refresh (No Network)
nodes.rationale: Re-runs collect_sheet_audit locally against the TUI's already-in-memory AwardsData immediately after a write completes, piggybacking on the same local-patch step apply_edit_result/apply_delete_result/apply_rename_result already perform, so FR-006 is satisfied with zero new network calls, per the constitution's Performance principle.

nodes.label: apply_user_view Reuse (Local Lookup)
nodes.rationale: Reuses the existing apply_user_view(username, select, status), which operates entirely on the TUI's already-loaded in-memory AwardsData.index with no network fetch — the same local-only pattern 002-audit-fix-selection's research already established for post-fix list refresh, adding zero new network calls.

nodes.label: Proof Handling (Never Processed)
nodes.rationale: extract_paste_fields never looks for a 'Proof:' label at all, satisfying FR-008 by construction (no code path for that text to travel down) rather than extracting proof text and then being careful not to act on it; the clerk still sees it only in the transient paste buffer.

nodes.label: CLI Parity Gap (Audit Fix Selection)
nodes.rationale: No new CLI flag is added — 'select from a list' has no meaning in a one-shot CLI command; the clerk already has equivalent one-shot flags (--edit/--cell, --delete, --rename) to act on anything the --audit report names. Explicitly documented per the constitution's UX Consistency principle requirement to call out any CLI/TUI parity gap rather than accept it silently.

nodes.label: Stale-Write Guard Reuse
nodes.rationale: No new staleness mechanism is introduced: find_live_row/live_cell_value/cell_stale_message inside add_award_to_user/update_award_cell/remove_award/rename_username already re-check the live cell before writing; a fix launched from a selected audit finding goes through these exact functions, satisfying FR-007 and the constitution's Security & Data Integrity principle with zero new code.

nodes.label: CLI Parity Gap (Discord Paste Quick-Add)
nodes.rationale: No new CLI flag is added — bracketed-paste ingestion of a multi-line message is an inherently interactive terminal capability with no scripted equivalent; the clerk already has --add <AWARD> --suffix <SUFFIX> once username/award are known off the message.
